FN-TBKLR55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 249
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/09/2026
Senate Bill 249 as introduced would increase the annual additional fee for the issuance of
distinctive vehicle license plates, from $1 under current law to $10, to firefighters, volunteer
firefighters and professional firefighters.
This bill would also provide for the distribution of these funds as shown below, which would
increase estimated receipts to the entities listed by the amounts shown:
